response.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CENTROMEA), ''), '(missing)') AS status,
         GOT - GPT AS ast_alt,
         APTT - PT AS aptt_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC > 6.5
),
per_status AS (
  SELECT status,
         AVG(ast_alt) AS avg_ast_alt,
         AVG(aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt,
       AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_status;

assumptions.assumption: The WBC cutoff is a filter that keeps only lab records with WBC strictly greater than 6.5; records with NULL WBC are excluded.
A missing anti-centromere status means NULL or a blank/whitespace-only string; both are grouped together as '(missing)'.

Each row of Laboratory is one individual lab record. AST−ALT and APTT−PT are computed per row, and rows with a NULL in either input are dropped from that metric's average (AVG ignores NULLs). A status with no computable values for a metric is ignored in the final average for that metric.
The final figures are plain AVG results with no ROUND, so they are unrounded (SQLite returns REAL values).

alternatives.interpretation: The WBC cutoff is a grouping split rather than a filter: each anti-centromere status is subdivided into WBC above 6.5 and WBC at or below 6.5, and each resulting combined group counts as one status in the final average. Records with NULL WBC are excluded.
alternatives.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CENTROMEA), ''), '(missing)') || ' | WBC ' || CASE WHEN WBC > 6.5 THEN '> 6.5' ELSE '<= 6.5' END AS status,
         GOT - GPT AS ast_alt,
         APTT - PT AS aptt_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC IS NOT NULL
),
per_status AS (
  SELECT status,
         AVG(ast_alt) AS avg_ast_alt,
         AVG(aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt,
       AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_status;

alternatives.interpretation: The WBC cutoff is ignored and all lab records are used, grouped only by anti-centromere status.
